item.title: A Message from New Director of Columbus Recreation and Parks
item.description:
Dear Colleagues,

I am deeply honored to have been selected as the new director of Columbus Recreation and Parks Department. I love this city, in great part because of people like you who make it special.

I am keenly aware of how difficult the last couple of years have been. The pandemic made much of what the department does incredibly challenging, but you faced it with perseverance and dedication. Our community – especially our youth – benefitted from your commitment. Paul Rakosky deserves special recognition for his unwavering leadership during this unprecedented time.

Being without a permanent director has also been a stressor to all of you, and I want to let you know how excited I am to be filling this role. We have a great department and great staff. It is my job to assure that CRPD is fulfilling the needs of our community, and I need all of you to make that happen. We will work collaboratively with other city departments, the Recreation and Parks Commission and City Hall to set the path and accomplish new things.

Change can be hard, but the results will pay off for us and the community we serve.

I look forward to reconnecting with each of you in the coming weeks and months.

Sincerely,
Bernita Reese
